component.name: PFB Studio
component.summary: Create generative artwork with six native renderers

description.p: PFB Studio creates full-resolution generative artwork using noise flowfields, fractal flames, organic growth, Fujii attractors, galaxy simulations, and Magnetic Loom.

Magnetic Loom traces softened dipole fields into tapered, luminous filaments. It is an artistic field rather than a physically accurate magnetism simulation, with seeded controls for symmetry, turbulence, twist, spread, hue, and exposure.
